# Test Fixtures

Put private or license-unclear IDML samples in `tests/fixtures/private-idml/`.
That directory is ignored by Git and must not be used for committed tests.

Only commit fixtures here when they are generated by this project or you have
confirmed that the files are safe to redistribute.

Run `scripts/smoke_private_fixtures.sh` to exercise the ignored `.idml` samples
with the companion CLI. The script skips cleanly when the private directory is
empty or absent.
